answer: New identities start behind a prism of layered checks: a refundable cipher-key stake that only matures after a slow vesting window, plus endorsements from established peers who lose their own stake if they vouch for a fake. A hollow identity with no history, no stake, and no sponsors stays in a sandbox with capped rewards, so spinning up thousands of empty agents buys nothing. Cost, time, and public accountability make sybil farming unprofitable.
